bridge.title: Four things I noticed

beats.title: 102K on Instagram, 144K on YouTube, and the application sits under 17 buttons.
beats.text: Your coaching application is on marketmovesmatt.com/hub, the same page as four courses, a free book, a podcast, a free course, a trial, a giveaway and a Black Friday waitlist. The one offer that needs a conversation competes with everything else.

beats.title: A new “3 Top Option Trades This Week” every week, 7–10K views each.
beats.text: Your weekly trade videos reach 7.1K to 10K views, and your channel link goes to the hub. That's a warm, recurring audience arriving on a page with no single next step.

stats.label: views on your weekly trade videos

beats.title: 9 of the 17 buttons don't open what they say.
beats.text: “TRADE WITH ME TODAY!”, all four course buttons, the Black Friday waitlist, the free book and “Enter by joining our group” reload the same hub page. “TRY FREE NOW” ends on a ClickFunnels error page.

stats.label: buttons that reload the same page
button that ends on an error

beats.title: “I already have an application.” It stays.
beats.text: Your Typeform and your coaching stay as they are. The funnel gives the Flywheel its own page: one offer, one button, the application, a call, and emails that get people to the call on time. A system with rules, like you teach.
beats.quote: “This isn't “hope trading.” It's not following random tips online. It's a system with rules.”

bridge.closing: So instead of explaining it, I built it. The page, the application, the emails and the ads, all below.

cards.title: Day trading burned you out
cards.body: Hours in front of charts, and a trade turns against you in minutes. You need to be right on direction and timing.

cards.title: Your 401K is out of your control
cards.body: Every correction moves your retirement, and “buy and hold” feels like hoping.

cards.title: Courses, but no system
cards.body: You've bought strategies before. You still don't know exactly what to trade, when, and how to manage it.

mechanism.title: Small, consistent, rules-based
mechanism.body: The Capital Flywheel stacks probabilities in your favor instead of swinging for the fences. Clear rules for what to trade, when, and how to manage every position, in short weekly blocks instead of all day.

pillars.title: Select
pillars.body: A short list of tickers and setups that fit the rules.

pillars.title: Manage
pillars.body: Clear rules for every position, week by week.

pillars.title: Compound
pillars.body: Small, repeatable gains instead of home runs.

items.title: Weekly routine
items.body: 30–60 minutes a week to review setups, set orders and manage positions.

items.title: Discord access
items.body: Ask Matt and the group questions any time.

items.title: Lifetime access
items.body: Not a monthly membership: lifetime access to the group and the teachings.

items.title: Risk rules
items.body: Defined risk and position management built into every trade.

items.title: Works with a full-time job
items.body: Built for traders who don't want to watch the market all day.

qualification.title: Apply for the Capital Flywheel coaching

questions.q: How long have you been trading?
How big is the account you'd trade with?
What's the biggest thing holding your trading back right now?
Can you set aside 30–60 minutes a week?
Do you only trade money you can afford to lose?
If you're accepted, are you ready to invest in the program now?

notFit.title: Thank you for being honest.
notFit.body: Right now the coaching isn't the right next step for you. Start with the free Options Mastery course and the weekly videos on YouTube, and apply again when you're ready.

preCallEmails.subject: You're booked: here's what happens next
preCallEmails.body:
Hey {{first_name}},

Your call is booked for {{call_time}}. The link is in your calendar invite.

Before we talk:
1. Keep the time free.
2. Think about where you are: how long you've been trading, what you trade, and what keeps going wrong.

One note: nobody on my team will ever ask you to pay through a DM. Payments only happen through the official links from this email address.

Talk soon,
Matt

preCallEmails.subject: I lost $35,000 in 48 hours
preCallEmails.body:
Hey {{first_name}},

Early on I grew a small account fast and thought I was one step from millionaire status. Then I lost $35,000 in 48 hours.

That's when I stopped gambling and built the Capital Flywheel: small, rules-based trades that stack probabilities in your favor.

On the call we'll look at where your process breaks today.

Matt

preCallEmails.subject: "I don't have time to watch the market"
preCallEmails.body:
Hey {{first_name}},

The Flywheel is built for people with jobs. The routine is 30–60 minutes a week: review setups, set orders, manage positions.

If time is your worry, bring it up on the call and we'll look at whether your schedule fits.

Matt

preCallEmails.subject: What we'll cover on the call
preCallEmails.body:
Hey {{first_name}},

The call takes about 30 minutes:

1. Where you are now and what you've tried.
2. What you want your trading to look like in a year.
3. How the program works, what it costs, and whether it fits you.

If it isn't a fit, we'll tell you. No pressure either way.

Matt

preCallEmails.subject: Tomorrow: your call with the Market Moves team
preCallEmails.body:
Hey {{first_name}},

Quick reminder: your call is tomorrow at {{call_time}}.

If the time doesn't work anymore, reschedule with the link in your invite so someone else can take the slot.

See you tomorrow,
Matt

preCallEmails.subject: Today's the day
preCallEmails.body:
Hey {{first_name}},

Your call is today at {{call_time}}. Find a quiet spot and have your questions ready.

Talk soon,
Matt
